copy.description:
Pet hair on the couch and rugs is a daily job for many dog and cat parents. This mini pet hair remover tool, per the maker, is a reusable option for pet hair on couches and rugs.

It is made of plastic and has a listed weight of about 7 oz (200 g) in the red version. Check the photos and product details to confirm it suits your fabric and the amount of hair you need to clear.

Because the maker lists it as reusable, you can clear the hair from it and use it again. For large rooms or heavy shedding, a full-size brush or roller may be a better fit.

Ships from a US warehouse, and the shipping window is listed in the FAQ below. Each unit arrives in a plastic bag, per the maker's packing listing.
